lines.speaker: kite_pilot
lines.text: Kite's guns are gone. It sheared them right off the hull.

lines.speaker: wren_pilot
lines.text: Wren too. No guns left. Just engines and a lot of hull.

lines.speaker: wren_pilot
lines.text: Dov, take the stern. I'll take the bow. Its shield can't cover both ends at once.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Negative! Fall back on Kestrel. Sefa, Dov, that's an order!

lines.speaker: kite_pilot
lines.text: Respectfully, Captain: no. Get Teo and Moss home.

lines.speaker: wren_pilot
lines.text: You've got a promise waiting at Meridian, Vey. Go and keep it.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: Bow and stern. They hit both ends. Its shield is down, Captain. It's open.
